era_setting.place: Genoa, Liguria, Italy -- the Polcevera valley between the Certosa, Campi and Rivarolo quarters, the A10 Genova-Savona motorway at km 000+551, the port and the hills above it; the Tribunale di Genova for the 2022-2026 trial; Rome for the Ministry of Infrastructure and Transport
era_setting.notes: The film runs from Riccardo Morandi's 1962 design to the first-instance judgment of 16 July 2026, and its centre of gravity is 11:36 on 14 August 2018. This is a MODERN setting for everything after 1990, so contemporary stock is period-correct, and this episode is the one in the batch where the shelf's European bias is an ADVANTAGE rather than an error. What is WRONG is the COUNTRY, the REGISTER and the DRIVING SIDE. OUT OF PLACE, and wrong in any cut: American highway signage, US route shields and US number plates; British streets and right-hand-drive traffic (Italy drives on the right, so a right-hand-drive vehicle is wrong even in a European street); Asian or Latin American cityscapes; Northern-European brick terraces; megacity skylines; palm-lined boulevards, desert, ocean surf. ALSO WRONG, and the easier trap: the HOLIDAY-ITALY register. Tuscan hills, cypress avenues, vineyards, the Amalfi coast, Venetian canals and gondolas, the Colosseum and Roman ruins are a different country from this film. Genoa is a working Mediterranean port city -- container cranes, ferries, tight ochre and grey blocks stacked up steep hills, railway yards, warehouses, a river bed of concrete and gravel, motorway viaducts and tunnels running through and over housing. Italian lettering in frame must be UNREADABLE rather than ABSENT: a Ligurian street with no writing anywhere reads as a set. OUT OF PERIOD: horse traffic, steam trains, pre-1960 cars as ordinary traffic in a post-1990 scene, CRT televisions in a 2018 interior, rotary telephones. Declared because EP62 greene shipped a 2011 Range Rover on an EU plate past a green pre-flight, and because for THIS episode the inverse error -- an American street -- is the one the shelf will offer first. footage_review_required is true and a labelled contact sheet must be opened by a person before any clip enters a cut.

forbidden_claims: That any named person caused the collapse, is guilty, or is responsible, stated flatly. On 16 July 2026 the Tribunale di Genova (RG NR 10468/18, RG DIB 2037/22, president Dott. Paolo Lepri) convicted 32 defendants AT FIRST INSTANCE and acquitted, or declared time-barred, the rest. The written reasons were given a ninety-day deadline and had not been filed when this film was written, and the defence announced an appeal. Italy has three instances: a first-instance outcome is not a final one. Wherever a convicted person is named, the words 'convicted at first instance' and 'the judgment is not final' appear in the same breath; wherever an acquitted person is named -- Roberto Ferrazza above all -- the acquittal appears in the same breath. This binds the title, the thumbnail text, the description and every figure card exactly as it binds the narration.

That anyone intended the collapse, foresaw it, or acted knowing it would happen. The same judgment ACQUITTED every defendant charged under articles 432 and 437 of the criminal code 'perche il fatto non sussiste', and excluded the aggravating circumstance of article 61 no. 3 -- conscious negligence -- for all of them. The convictions are for negligence. The film may not use 'deliberately', 'knowingly let it fall', 'they knew it would collapse', or any equivalent.

That Riccardo Morandi predicted, foresaw or warned of this collapse. What the primary record establishes is narrower: Aspi commissioned a report from him in 1981, and from the 1980s onward the viaduct was the subject of a series of ordinary and extraordinary maintenance interventions. The contents of that 1981 report have NOT been read in the primary document. Narrate the narrower statement.
That the collapse was foreseen, predicted or inevitable, stated as fact. The record supports specific, dated, sourced statements about what particular documents said, and nothing wider.

A single agreed cause. Two authoritative findings disagree and both must be given with their date and author: the MIT Commissione Ispettiva (14 September 2018) held it more likely that the first cause lay NOT in the rupture of one or more stays but in one of the remaining structural elements, whose survival was conditioned by advanced corrosion; the court-appointed experts' report filed in December 2020 identified corrosion of the upper part of the south, Genoa-side tirante of pier 9.
That the collapse was caused by the storm, by lightning, by a wind gust, or by the load of any one vehicle. None of these is a finding in anything retrieved.
Any name, face, likeness, age or personal detail of any of the 43 people who died, of the 13 injured, or of their families. The film names none of them and shows none of them.

That the new Genova San Giorgio viaduct carries 43 lamps, one for each of the dead. The original design called for 43 light points and the number was reduced. Say what was built, not what was reported.

That Autostrade per l'Italia or Spea, as companies, have been criminally convicted. The operative part read for this film disposes of natural persons; corporate liability is not established by anything retrieved.
Any figure for deaths, injuries, metres, years, euros, percentages, scores or sentences that is not a row in EP76_morandi_FACTS_LEDGER with a source.

R3: 43 real deaths, 13 injured, living families, and 57 defendants of whom 32 were convicted at first instance one month before this film was written and 25 were acquitted or time-barred -- forbidden_claims is the legally load-bearing part of this spec and it governs the packaging as strictly as the narration.
